en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing the interior of a small Catholic chapel with wooden pews facing an ornate altar. The altar is richly decorated with statues, framed religious images, flowers, candles, and patterned drapes. Above the altar are several angel figures along the upper wall. The reverse side has printed and handwritten Hungarian text, with printed description at upper left and purple ink handwriting covering much of the card.
